name: Giraffids
description: Giraffids are hoofed ruminant Mammals, represented today only by the giraffe and the okapi. $(br2)Common characteristics of giraffids include skin-covered, horn-like ossicones, long legs, and long, dark tongues used to strip leaves from branches. $(br2)Extinct giraffids were far more diverse, including massive, short-necked forms that once ranged across Africa, Europe and Asia.
